entries.name: Skeleton
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Bare aged-ivory skeleton, open ribcage, single lowered straight sword, empty forward hand and native right-facing bent-knee idle remain readable at shared scale.
entries.limits: Generated skull/bone surfaces are more explicit and creamier; silhouette is slightly narrower. Static proposal only.

entries.name: Skeleton Warrior
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared the final repaired master: dark spiked helmet, muted violet torso armor, dark boots, lowered sword and oblique bronze-rim shield distinguish the upgrade. The invented forearm bracer was removed and shield grip/perspective corrected.
entries.limits: Small armor seams, wear and fittings are interpretations; the high-resolution surface is denser than the source.

entries.name: Walking Dead
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared the selected second attempt after head/proportion repair: exposed pale torso, damaged rear calf, bare feet, ragged dark trousers and single short cleaver distinguish the base from Zombie.
entries.limits: Silhouette is about 9 percent wider; body decay/rib detail remains stronger than native. Low-alpha fringe noted by worker; not runtime checked.

entries.name: Zombie
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Pale gaunt figure, brown/olive sleeveless outfit, short dark hair/head interpretation, asymmetric one-boot/one-bare-foot and low wooden-shaft tool remain visibly distinct from Walking Dead.
entries.limits: About 10 percent wider silhouette; tiny fasteners, hair and tool construction are source-informed interpretations.

entries.name: Wight
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared final repaired master after broadening needle-like proportions and removing an extra pale hand-like shape. Brown hood, close two-hand idle, pale face/throat and tapered floating robe retain the original identity.
entries.limits: Fine cloth grain is more etched/ornamental; throat and layered tatters are interpreted. This material difference needs human judgment, not mechanical clearance.

entries.name: Wraith
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Dark brown-black cowl and long robe, pale skull/throat fringe and close skeletal hands are coherent with Wight while retaining the darker upgrade treatment; no weapon or added glow.
entries.limits: Skull, throat fringe and cloth tatters are more explicit than native; slightly narrower silhouette. Fine finger/fringe detail merges at display scale.

entries.name: Vampire
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared final claw-repaired master: pale bald pointed-eared head, dark fitted ragged outfit, low hunched ready pose, two clawed empty hands and boots preserve the base vampire rather than an invented noble/red cape.
entries.limits: Small face, seams and nail detail are interpreted; silhouette about 4 percent narrower than native.

entries.name: Vampire Lord
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared final second attempt: rust-orange high collar and sleeve tatters, dark long robe, hunched pale bald face and empty bony hands visibly distinguish the upgrade from the dark fitted base Vampire. Scorched-surface and exaggerated claw treatment was softened.
entries.limits: Ears and cloth wear remain more pronounced; silhouette narrower than native. The robe grain is an interpreted surface, not uniquely recoverable source detail.

entries.name: Lich
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Original skeletal figure retains a simple dark gold-banded cap, short chain skirt, exposed leg bones, dark boots and simple upright staff; not the crowned long-skirt/crescent-staff Power Lich.
entries.limits: About 13 percent narrower silhouette; cap geometry, chainmail links and small armor/face construction are interpreted. Native pose is approximate rather than traced.

entries.name: Power Lich
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared final repaired full master and eye-detail plate against the actual native head crop. Crown, extensive mail skirt, gold-trimmed dark armor and black-orb crescent staff distinguish the upgrade. Two restrained red socket accents were restored after an incorrect removal; no visible aura or halo.
entries.limits: Far socket is tiny at display size; silhouette about 5 percent narrower and mail more regularly resolved. Worker separately reports that its generated-eye composite preserves all non-eye pixels and alpha.

entries.name: Black Knight
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared final sixth master with darker near-black navy armor, restrained simple hilt, continuous curved blade, dark hooves and complete muzzle. Native red accents, dark unarmored horse and red saddle cloth remain distinct from Dread Knight.
entries.limits: Four percent wider than target. Rein-hand remains somewhat higher than native; horse anatomy, tack, armor seams and helmet prong proportions are interpreted rather than traced. Mounted scale is retained, not normalized to humanoid height.

entries.name: Dread Knight
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared final repaired master: enclosed plumed helm, pale metal shoulder/horse face spikes, silver barding, red fringe and one smooth curved saber preserve the upgraded mounted identity. Invented chest spike, warm gold edging and blade barbs were removed.
entries.limits: Fine fasteners and barding surfaces are resolved beyond source detail; tiny rivets soften at display scale. Static horse/rider pose is approximate.

entries.name: Bone Dragon
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared selected fourth master: aged warm ivory/yellow skeleton, exposed ribs/vertebrae, open skull, folded dark desiccated membranes, bony wing fingers, two raised foreclaws, bent hind legs and low articulated tail. Entire horns, wings, claws and tail fit at shared scale.
entries.limits: Bone contours, horns/spines and membrane tearing are more elaborate interpretations; silhouette four pixels narrower than target. No full animation continuity review yet.

entries.name: Ghost Dragon
entries.review_method: parent directly viewed source-vs-master PNG: source and generated figure at shared scale plus enlarged inspection; source roster and approved Pikeman benchmark also viewed
entries.observed: Compared final master to CHDRGN source and full lineup. Pale silver-white/cool-gray skeleton and ragged membranes retain the upgrade color treatment and contrast with warm Bone Dragon, without living scales, blue flames or a large aura. Complete upright body, wing fingers, feet and tail remain framed.
entries.limits: Twelve pixels narrower than native target; skull/spines/claw hooks are more elaborate and far wing partly hidden. Static source likeness is a proposal, not motion or runtime evidence.

limits: Art judgment is a source-faithfulness proposal, not human acceptance.
Source-sequence counts/offsets are verified separately; entire animation motion has not been reviewed or generated.
No engine import, playback in browser, editor, gameplay or runtime validation.
